source: Supplied directly by the owner, August 2026. Current professional set — these supersede the older interior shots carried over from the previous website.

photos.alt: Aerial view of the River House on its three riverfront acres, showing the saltwater pool, the house and the Savannah River curving past the treeline
The saltwater pool in front of the two-storey River House, with the Savannah River and Adirondack chairs beyond
Wide view of the saltwater pool and the River House, with the river and lawn stretching out behind
The River House seen across the pool, with its upper balcony, exterior staircase and covered lower deck
The saltwater pool looking out over the Savannah River, with lawn, Adirondack chairs and the dock beyond
A largemouth bass caught from the private dock on the Savannah River
The Welcome to The River House sign set among flowering shrubs on the lawn
The River House directional sign at the entrance to the property driveway
Entry hall with a baker's rack, opening through to the bathroom and the spiral staircase
The spiral staircase connecting the two levels of the River House, with tiled landing below
Landing with the spiral staircase, fresh towels on a stand and the bathroom beyond
Entrance area with a full-length mirror, stacked towels and the bathroom doorway
Bathroom with a tiled tub and shower and fresh towels on the rail
Walk-in closet with fitted shelving, hanging rails and folded linens
Laundry area with a full-size washer and dryer beneath fitted cabinets
Second laundry area with washer, dryer, utility sink and worktop
